correctness.rationale: Complete graph geometry is reconstructed from the classical affine-plane Hesse incidence: 21 components, 48 simple intersections. The exact reduced integer Laplacian has determinant 3^10*7^8 and integral 21*B^-1. The general perfect graph pairing identifies the Frobenius-fixed abstract invariant factors with the explicit coinvariant presentation. Eleven conjugacy classes exhaust all 432 affine actions; exact modulo-3 and modulo-7 ranks are checked for every group element and independent integer Smith forms are checked for all eleven representatives with two sink choices. Group generators verify zero full Hessian invariants. All computations replay successfully from the standalone embedded script.

value.rationale: The 21-curve Hesse divisor is a canonical complete boundary of the extremal rational elliptic surface, and affine Galois action is dictated by its 3-torsion geometry. The full eleven-class arithmetic fixed-group classification is a natural complete integral invariant finer than the previously known nonequivariant critical group and ordinary curve/node cycle data. The two order-eight classes lose all 3-primary invariant classes but retain one C7, while the full 216-element Hessian group fixes nothing even though each element fixes a nonzero class. These are motivated structural features rather than arbitrary slices or mere software output.
